title: skil MCP surface lock v1
description: Full-surface MCP integrity lock (.skil/mcp-surface.lock.json): unlike mcp-tools-lock-v1's tool-description-only digests, each entry here is a canonical-JSON digest of the entire reviewed object (a tool's name+description+input schema, a prompt's name+description, a resource's uri+name+description, or the server's own name+version+protocol version) — so a rug pull that keeps a tool's description but changes its input schema is still caught.
